import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def elements : BinarySearchTree → List Int
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => []
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => v :: (elements l ++ elements r)

def bstInsert : BinarySearchTree → Int → BinarySearchTree
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty, x =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node x
        BinarySearchTree.Empty BinarySearchTree.Empty
  | BinarySearchTree.Node y l r, x =>
      if x < y then
        BinarySearchTree.Node y (bstInsert l x) r
      else if x > y then
        BinarySearchTree.Node y l (bstInsert r x)
      else
        BinarySearchTree.Node y l r

def listView (xs : List Int) : Set Int :=
  {x | x ∈ xs}
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def delete (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t v) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ((elements t).filter (fun x => x ≠ v)).foldl
    bstInsert BinarySearchTree.Empty
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def delete_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : delete_precond t v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t \ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem mem_elements_iff (t : BinarySearchTree) (x : Int) :
    x ∈ elements t ↔ x ∈ view t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      simp [elements, view]
  | Node y l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [elements, List.mem_cons, List.mem_append, view,
        Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff, ihl, ihr]
      tauto

theorem view_bstInsert (t : BinarySearchTree) (x : Int) :
    view (bstInsert t x) = view t ∪ {x} := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      simp [bstInsert, view]
  | Node y l r ihl ihr =>
      by_cases hlt : x < y
      · rw [bstInsert, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [view]
        rw [ihl]
        ext z
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        tauto
      · by_cases hgt : x > y
        · rw [bstInsert, if_neg hlt, if_pos hgt]
          simp only [view]
          rw [ihr]
          ext z
          simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          tauto
        · have hxy : x = y := by
            omega
          subst x
          ext z
          simp [bstInsert, view]

theorem is_bst_bstInsert (t : BinarySearchTree) (x : Int)
    (ht : is_bst t) :
    is_bst (bstInsert t x) := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      simp [bstInsert, is_bst, view]
  | Node y l r ihl ihr =>
      rcases ht with ⟨hl, hbl, hr, hbr⟩
      by_cases hlt : x < y
      · rw [bstInsert, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [is_bst]
        refine ⟨?_, ihl hbl, hr, hbr⟩
        intro z hz
        rw [view_bstInsert] at hz
        have hz' : z ∈ view l ∨ z = x := by
          simpa only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hz
        rcases hz' with hz | hz
        · exact hl z hz
        · omega
      · by_cases hgt : x > y
        · rw [bstInsert, if_neg hlt, if_pos hgt]
          simp only [is_bst]
          refine ⟨hl, hbl, ?_, ihr hbr⟩
          intro z hz
          rw [view_bstInsert] at hz
          have hz' : z ∈ view r ∨ z = x := by
            simpa only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hz
          rcases hz' with hz | hz
          · exact hr z hz
          · omega
        · have hxy : x = y := by
            omega
          subst x
          have hold : is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node y l r) :=
            ⟨hl, hbl, hr, hbr⟩
          simpa [bstInsert] using hold

theorem is_bst_foldl_bstInsert
    (xs : List Int) (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (ht : is_bst t) :
    is_bst (xs.foldl bstInsert t) := by
  induction xs generalizing t with
  | nil =>
      simpa
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      exact ih (bstInsert t x) (is_bst_bstInsert t x ht)

theorem view_foldl_bstInsert
    (xs : List Int) (t : BinarySearchTree) :
    view (xs.foldl bstInsert t) = view t ∪ listView xs := by
  induction xs generalizing t with
  | nil =>
      simp [listView]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rw [ih, view_bstInsert]
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff, listView,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq, List.mem_cons]
      tauto
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem delete_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : delete_precond t v) :
    delete_postcond t v (delete t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  constructor
  · unfold delete
    apply is_bst_foldl_bstInsert
    simp [is_bst]
  · unfold delete
    rw [view_foldl_bstInsert]
    ext x
    simp [listView, mem_elements_iff, view]
  -- !benchmark @end proof

  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => v :: (elements l ++ elements r)

  | BinarySearchTree.Node y l r, x =>
